title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree.
answer: Walk left when both values are smaller, right when both are larger; otherwise the current node is the split point. Time: O(h); space: O(1).

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree.
answer: Return a target when found; combine left and right recursive results. A node with hits from both sides is the LCA. Time: O(n); space: O(h).

title: Product of Array Except Self
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Product of Array Except Self.
answer: Store prefix products in the output, then multiply by a running suffix product. Time: O(n); space: O(1) extra, excluding output.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Sliding Window Maximum.
answer: Maintain indices in decreasing-value order, removing expired indices and smaller trailing values. Time: O(n); space: O(k).

title: Search a 2D Matrix II
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Search a 2D Matrix II.
answer: Start at the top-right; move left if too large and down if too small. Time: O(m+n); space: O(1).

title: Valid Anagram
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Valid Anagram.
answer: Reject unequal lengths, then compare character frequency counts. Time: O(n); space: O(1) for lowercase English letters.

title: Missing Number
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Missing Number.
answer: XOR all indices and values; paired values cancel, leaving the missing integer. Time: O(n); space: O(1).

title: Find the Duplicate Number
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Find the Duplicate Number.
answer: Count values at most mid; a count greater than mid means the duplicate lies in the lower half. Time: O(n log n); space: O(1).

title: Find Median from Data Stream
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Find Median from Data Stream.
answer: Keep a max-heap for the lower half and min-heap for the upper half, balanced so lower has at most one extra item. Time: O(log n) per insertion; O(1) median; space: O(n).

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
question: Explain the core idea and complexity for Longest Increasing Subsequence.
answer: Maintain minimal tails for each subsequence length and binary-search the first tail not smaller than each value. Time: O(n log n); space: O(n).
